name: GET /api/media/:blob_id/playback-url - Issue presigned playback URL

testCases.name: Issue 10min playback URL for the uploaded blob

description: Issues a presigned, time-limited playback/download URL for a ready blob (FR-MED-4) and returns 200 with the URL and expiry. Both a tenant_id claim and a sub claim are required on the JWT - a missing tenant_id is a 403 while a missing sub is a 401 - and the blob's tenant is asserted against the caller's. Edge cases: the optional ttl_seconds query parameter must parse as a positive finite number (0, negative and non-numeric values are 400s) and any oversized value is silently clamped down to the service maximum rather than rejected; an unknown blob_id is a 404; a blob owned by another tenant is a 403; a blob whose key material has been shredded is a 410 Gone; the access is attributed to the caller's persona, so this route is not side-effect free.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
The token verifies but carries no tenant_id claim
The token carries a tenant_id but no sub claim to attribute the playback access to

errorCases.message: ttl_seconds must be a positive number
errorCases.when: ttl_seconds is supplied but is non-numeric, NaN/Infinity, zero or negative

errorCases.message: issuePlaybackUrl: caller tenant <tid> does not own this blob
errorCases.when: The blob's tenant_id differs from the JWT tenant_id claim
No blob row exists for the supplied blob_id
The blob key material was shredded, so it can no longer be played back
Any other issuePlaybackUrl failure - notably no S3 signer registered in production, or a database error
